detail.title: Dual Arm Articulating Monitor Desk Mount
detail.overview: The Ant Esports MA112 is a dual-arm articulating monitor mount built from reinforced steel, holding two screens from 13 to 32 inches, each weighing up to 8kg (17.6lb). Highly adjustable arms offer ±45-degree tilt, ±90-degree swivel and full 360-degree rotation, letting you position both monitors in portrait or landscape orientation to suit any dual-screen workflow. Height adjustment along the centre pole reaches up to 16.3 inches above the desk, freeing up genuine space below for a laptop, keyboard, speakers or other desk essentials. Both C-clamp and grommet base mounting hardware are included, fitting desks from 0.39 to 3.15 inches thick, with a detachable VESA plate (75x75mm or 100x100mm) for straightforward setup and a reinforced base plate for extra sturdiness under the weight of two larger monitors.
